$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Offline Knowledge bundle (REC-NOMAD-01). install.py requests app.install, then app.configure with settings keyed by manifest field name; the owner approves every action.
name: Offline Knowledge
description: Offline Wikipedia and other books, courses, maps of your region and a local AI that answers from your library. Works with no internet once downloaded.

apps.why: the library: Wikipedia and other books (ZIM files)
ask the library questions; answers cite the articles

starter.name: Starter (try it out)
starter.fits: any OneMind box with 4 GB RAM and 2 GB free disk

greenhouse-offgrid.name: Greenhouse and off-grid node
greenhouse-offgrid.fits: Raspberry Pi 5 8 GB (or any x86 box) with a 128 GB or larger SSD

map.note: pass --bbox for the area around the site, about 50 km across: a few hundred MiB at zoom 15
